author: ImRaging
body: Is it possible to set boundaries on maps? Like, for example, to stop players from getting into another spawn? This would reduce spawn killing and I certainly would want to implement it into the current map others and I are working on, if it is possible.

title: I have a question...

replies.author: piratewithgun
replies.body: yea it is possible but it is sometimes useful to run through the enemy spawn and also players have spawn protection when they have just spawned
replies.body_tagged: yea it is possible but it is sometimes useful to run through the enemy spawn and also players have spawn protection when they have just spawned

replies.author: piratewithgun
replies.body:
in the rules it says: No spawn killing. This is defined as killing players of other teams briefly after their spawning. Ensure you allow time for enemy team members to acknowledge their location and surroundings. 

this does not mean that you cant kill a player when they are in spawn. for example if they hit you first then they must have acknowledged their surroundings in which case it is legal to fight

replies.author: Riskayyy
replies.body:
Yes it is very possible.

YML:
regions:
  blue-spawn-example:
    type: cuboid
    min: x,y,z
    max: x,y,z
    flags:
      enter:
        who: 'red'
        message: '&c...'
